VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) confirms 72 tests pass (criterion 2), but there is no admissible evidence that the race condition itself was actually fixed (criterion 1). A passing test suite only verifies criterion 1 if a test specifically reproduces the race condition and now passes — and race conditions are notoriously non-deterministic, so a single green run does not demonstrate the fix. No diff, no new regression test targeting the race, and no proof the existing 72 tests exercise the concurrent code path. The self-report claim of "fix complete" is SELF-class and non-admissible for establishing the fix.
